_comment: What flutter-vita builds against, and its own release. Read by the CLI (precache, doctor, --version) and the build scripts. flutter and flutter_sdk are edited by hand at a Flutter upgrade; tools/publish-engine.sh writes engine, tools/publish-release.sh writes release and embedder (docs/release.md).

flutter_sdk._comment: Google's release archives of the pinned Flutter, by host. tools/flutter-sdk.sh downloads one, checks the sha256 and unpacks it to ~/.flutter-vita/flutter/<flutter>. Hashes from releases_<os>.json under base_url.

engine._comment: The engine release on flutter-vita/flutter. Its tag is the engine commit's first eight characters. tools/publish-engine.sh publishes it and then writes release, url and sha256 here; after a Flutter upgrade they stay empty until it runs (docs/release.md).
